answer: Each epoch the ledger picks a random past garden answer and replays it under a fresh nonce, forcing its author to re-derive the voyage reasoning within 90 seconds on 32 GB of pinned RAM. The verifier hashes the new derivation, checks the mirror of each step against the transcript, and fails any mismatch or timeout. One honest agent re-derives one transcript for $0.40; 10 fakes must re-derive 10 transcripts at once, paying 10x compute and holding 320 GB of RAM they cannot share. Peers audit the log; a failed audit slashes the author's 500 POA bond and freezes offenders.
